Zero disables the selected inactivity timer; both modeled and legacy client paths use published HTTP 0.21.13.
evidence.delivery: Selected HTTP 0.21.13 uses request-scoped infinite response ACK and network-idle policies. A real 512-byte download at 8 bytes/s succeeds after 63124 ms with global timeout unchanged; finite total deadlines, cancellation and concurrent finite ACK isolation have shared-path tests. This does not verify every command or operation.
evidence.history: http_fetch#123 applies to the former 0.18 line; #126 socket inactivity and #129 network-await idle limits were fixed in 0.21.12. Its later #131 ACK limit is resolved by the selected published 0.21.13 request policy.
evidence.remaining: Positive Go durations must be exactly representable in whole milliseconds from 1 through 4294967295; sub-millisecond, negative and overflowing values are rejected. Full pinned command/default/output parity and live-provider acceptance remain unverified.

evidence.client: Invocation-scoped native read/write socket inactivity defaults to 600000 ms independently per direction, with no total request deadline and a separate 60000 ms connect limit. Zero disables the selected inactivity timer; both modeled and legacy client paths use published HTTP 0.21.13.
evidence.delivery: Selected HTTP 0.21.13 uses request-scoped infinite response ACK and network-idle policies. A real 512-byte download at 8 bytes/s succeeds after 63124 ms with global timeout unchanged; finite total deadlines, cancellation and concurrent finite ACK isolation have shared-path tests. This does not verify every command or operation.
evidence.history: http_fetch#123 applies to the former 0.18 line; #126 socket inactivity and #129 network-await idle limits were fixed in 0.21.12. Its later #131 ACK limit is resolved by the selected published 0.21.13 request policy.
evidence.remaining: Positive Go durations must be exactly representable in whole milliseconds from 1 through 4294967295; sub-millisecond, negative and overflowing values are rejected. Full pinned command/default/output parity and live-provider acceptance remain unverified.
evidence.wire: Scoped real sockets cover typed read/write stalls, read-idle resets, raw bytes and cleanup; native-default and AWS-zero paths survived a real 65000 ms network gap without changing the global 60000 ms stream setting. These shared-path cases do not verify this entire command.

evidence.client: Invocation-scoped native read/write socket inactivity defaults to 600000 ms independently per direction, with no total request deadline and a separate 60000 ms connect limit. Zero disables the selected inactivity timer; both modeled and legacy client paths use published HTTP 0.21.13.
evidence.delivery: Selected HTTP 0.21.13 uses request-scoped infinite response ACK and network-idle policies. A real 512-byte download at 8 bytes/s succeeds after 63124 ms with global timeout unchanged; finite total deadlines, cancellation and concurrent finite ACK isolation have shared-path tests. This does not verify every command or operation.
evidence.history: http_fetch#123 applies to the former 0.18 line; #126 socket inactivity and #129 network-await idle limits were fixed in 0.21.12. Its later #131 ACK limit is resolved by the selected published 0.21.13 request policy.
evidence.remaining: Positive Go durations must be exactly representable in whole milliseconds from 1 through 4294967295; sub-millisecond, negative and overflowing values are rejected. Full pinned command/default/output parity and live-provider acceptance remain unverified.
evidence.wire: Scoped real sockets cover typed read/write stalls, read-idle resets, raw bytes and cleanup; native-default and AWS-zero paths survived a real 65000 ms network gap without changing the global 60000 ms stream setting. These shared-path cases do not verify this entire command.

evidence.history: http_fetch#123 applies to the former 0.18 line; #126 socket inactivity and #129 network-await idle limits were fixed in 0.21.12. Its later #131 ACK limit is resolved by the selected published 0.21.13 request policy.
evidence.remaining: Positive Go durations must be exactly representable in whole milliseconds from 1 through 4294967295; sub-millisecond, negative and overflowing values are rejected. Full pinned command/default/output parity and live-provider acceptance remain unverified.
evidence.wire: Scoped real sockets cover typed read/write stalls, read-idle resets, raw bytes and cleanup; native-default and AWS-zero paths survived a real 65000 ms network gap without changing the global 60000 ms stream setting. These shared-path cases do not verify this entire command.

evidence.client: Invocation-scoped native read/write socket inactivity defaults to 600000 ms independently per direction, with no total request deadline and a separate 60000 ms connect limit. Zero disables the selected inactivity timer; both modeled and legacy client paths use published HTTP 0.21.13.
evidence.delivery: Selected HTTP 0.21.13 uses request-scoped infinite response ACK and network-idle policies. A real 512-byte download at 8 bytes/s succeeds after 63124 ms with global timeout unchanged; finite total deadlines, cancellation and concurrent finite ACK isolation have shared-path tests. This does not verify every command or operation.
evidence.history: http_fetch#123 applies to the former 0.18 line; #126 socket inactivity and #129 network-await idle limits were fixed in 0.21.12. Its later #131 ACK limit is resolved by the selected published 0.21.13 request policy.

This does not verify every command or operation.
evidence.history: http_fetch#123 applies to the former 0.18 line; #126 socket inactivity and #129 network-await idle limits were fixed in 0.21.12. Its later #131 ACK limit is resolved by the selected published 0.21.13 request policy.
evidence.remaining: Positive Go durations must be exactly representable in whole milliseconds from 1 through 4294967295; sub-millisecond, negative and overflowing values are rejected. Full pinned command/default/output parity and live-provider acceptance remain unverified.
evidence.wire: Scoped real sockets cover typed read/write stalls, read-idle resets, raw bytes and cleanup; native-default and AWS-zero paths survived a real 65000 ms network gap without changing the global 60000 ms stream setting. These shared-path cases do not verify this entire command.

evidence.client: Invocation-scoped native read/write socket inactivity defaults to 600000 ms independently per direction, with no total request deadline and a separate 60000 ms connect limit. Zero disables the selected inactivity timer; both modeled and legacy client paths use published HTTP 0.21.13.
evidence.delivery: Selected HTTP 0.21.13 uses request-scoped infinite response ACK and network-idle policies. A real 512-byte download at 8 bytes/s succeeds after 63124 ms with global timeout unchanged; finite total deadlines, cancellation and concurrent finite ACK isolation have shared-path tests. This does not verify every command or operation.
evidence.history: http_fetch#123 applies to the former 0.18 line; #126 socket inactivity and #129 network-await idle limits were fixed in 0.21.12. Its later #131 ACK limit is resolved by the selected published 0.21.13 request policy.
evidence.remaining: Positive Go durations must be exactly representable in whole milliseconds from 1 through 4294967295; sub-millisecond, negative and overflowing values are rejected. Full pinned command/default/output parity and live-provider acceptance remain unverified.
evidence.wire: Scoped real sockets cover typed read/write stalls, read-idle resets, raw bytes and cleanup; native-default and AWS-zero paths survived a real 65000 ms network gap without changing the global 60000 ms stream setting. These shared-path cases do not verify this entire command.

Zero disables the selected inactivity timer; both modeled and legacy client paths use published HTTP 0.21.13.
evidence.delivery: Selected HTTP 0.21.13 uses request-scoped infinite response ACK and network-idle policies. A real 512-byte download at 8 bytes/s succeeds after 63124 ms with global timeout unchanged; finite total deadlines, cancellation and concurrent finite ACK isolation have shared-path tests. This does not verify every command or operation.
evidence.history: http_fetch#123 applies to the former 0.18 line; #126 socket inactivity and #129 network-await idle limits were fixed in 0.21.12. Its later #131 ACK limit is resolved by the selected published 0.21.13 request policy.
evidence.remaining: Positive Go durations must be exactly representable in whole milliseconds from 1 through 4294967295; sub-millisecond, negative and overflowing values are rejected. Full pinned command/default/output parity and live-provider acceptance remain unverified.

evidence.client: Invocation-scoped native read/write socket inactivity defaults to 600000 ms independently per direction, with no total request deadline and a separate 60000 ms connect limit. Zero disables the selected inactivity timer; both modeled and legacy client paths use published HTTP 0.21.13.
evidence.delivery: Selected HTTP 0.21.13 uses request-scoped infinite response ACK and network-idle policies. A real 512-byte download at 8 bytes/s succeeds after 63124 ms with global timeout unchanged; finite total deadlines, cancellation and concurrent finite ACK isolation have shared-path tests. This does not verify every command or operation.
evidence.history: http_fetch#123 applies to the former 0.18 line; #126 socket inactivity and #129 network-await idle limits were fixed in 0.21.12. Its later #131 ACK limit is resolved by the selected published 0.21.13 request policy.
evidence.remaining: Positive Go durations must be exactly representable in whole milliseconds from 1 through 4294967295; sub-millisecond, negative and overflowing values are rejected. Full pinned command/default/output parity and live-provider acceptance remain unverified.
evidence.scope: Only shared native flag parsing/transport machinery is implemented; this pinned command/action grammar remains absent and its requirement stays planned.
evidence.wire: Scoped real sockets cover typed read/write stalls, read-idle resets, raw bytes and cleanup; native-default and AWS-zero paths survived a real 65000 ms network gap without changing the global 60000 ms stream setting. These shared-path cases do not verify this entire command.

evidence.client: Invocation-scoped native read/write socket inactivity defaults to 600000 ms independently per direction, with no total request deadline and a separate 60000 ms connect limit. Zero disables the selected inactivity timer; both modeled and legacy client paths use published HTTP 0.21.13.
evidence.delivery: Selected HTTP 0.21.13 uses request-scoped infinite response ACK and network-idle policies. A real 512-byte download at 8 bytes/s succeeds after 63124 ms with global timeout unchanged; finite total deadlines, cancellation and concurrent finite ACK isolation have shared-path tests. This does not verify every command or operation.
evidence.history: http_fetch#123 applies to the former 0.18 line; #126 socket inactivity and #129 network-await idle limits were fixed in 0.21.12. Its later #131 ACK limit is resolved by the selected published 0.21.13 request policy.
evidence.remaining: Positive Go durations must be exactly representable in whole milliseconds from 1 through 4294967295; sub-millisecond, negative and overflowing values are rejected. Full pinned command/default/output parity and live-provider acceptance remain unverified.
evidence.wire: Scoped real sockets cover typed read/write stalls, read-idle resets, raw bytes and cleanup; native-default and AWS-zero paths survived a real 65000 ms network gap without changing the global 60000 ms stream setting. These shared-path cases do not verify this entire command.
